summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 資料中心建設帶動的電力基礎設施需求，Quanta Services 憑藉強勁的積壓訂單與現金流表現，持續獲得市場看好。

bullish.title: Big Tech Will Spend $735 Billion on Data Centers. This Boring Electrical Contractor Collects the Checks.
bullish.reason: 指出 Quanta Services 是 AI 巨頭資本支出下的核心受益者，負責關鍵的電力傳輸與變電站建設，具備長期成長護城河。

bullish.title: Quanta Targets Up to $2.5B FCF: Can Cash Momentum Stay Strong?
bullish.reason: 公司設定 2026 年自由現金流目標達 20 億至 25 億美元，顯示其營運效率與收款能力強勁，支撐股價動能。

bullish.title: Jim Cramer: This 'Terrific' Industrial Stock Is 'Done Going Down'
bullish.reason: 知名財經評論員 Jim Cramer 公開推薦，認為該工業股已擺脫下跌趨勢，具備成長潛力。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR) Shows High Growth and Improving Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 透過量化篩選模型顯示公司在盈餘修正、營收成長及現金流表現上均優於市場預期。

bullish.title: 2 Growth Stocks With Strong Earnings Prospects to Buy in October
bullish.reason: 將 Quanta Services 與 NVIDIA 並列為 10 月份具備強勁盈餘成長前景的投資標的。

bearish.title: Truist Securities Maintains Buy on Quanta Services, Lowers Price Target to $945
bearish.reason: 雖然維持買入評級，但下調目標價反映了市場對高估值環境下執行風險的擔憂。

neutral.title: Is Quanta Services (PWR) Fully Priced After The Sector Rally And Cash Flow Lift?
neutral.reason: 探討在股價經歷 5.4% 的強勁反彈後，市場是否已充分反映其基本面利多，持保留觀察態度。

neutral.title: Quanta Services vs. MasTec: Is Better Cash Flow Worth a 73% Earnings Premium?
neutral.reason: 透過與同業 MasTec 比較，分析其 73% 的盈餘溢價是否合理，屬於估值合理性的中性探討。
